boundary: Host page.evaluate request through returned SVG string, including RPC serialization, shared public adapter and render cleanup; package initialization/import, browser/context startup and correctness grading excluded

controls.method: Exact two-sided sign/order-statistic interval for the median round ratio; assumes independent representative rounds. No within-round call resampling.
controls.detail: A finite interval does not remove systematic host, workload or artifact differences.

interpretation: Time for the exact fixed corpus through the declared boundary. All sampled outputs are independently checked. A/A spread and median round uncertainty remain separate; calibration alone is not a confidence claim.
